prompt:
Image 1 is the floor plan of a room seen from above: its bottom edge is the front wall, its top edge the back wall, its left edge the left wall and its right edge the right wall. Image 2 is the front view of the same room (the establishing view), taken from the centre of the front wall facing the back wall. Generate one photorealistic cinematic still of this same room, empty of people, from a new camera position: the back view: the camera stands at the centre of the back wall, at eye level, facing the front wall, turned 180 degrees from Image 2, so the left wall is at the right edge of the frame and the right wall at its left edge. Turn the camera for real: this view must not show the back wall's furniture head-on unless it is the wall being faced. Keep every wall, door, window, piece of furniture, material, colour and light exactly as Image 1 and Image 2 show them, seen from this new side; the room layout and furniture placement exactly match Image 1. Location: Garden of the wedding venue. A small, elegant present-day outdoor wedding garden on a manicured green lawn, in sunny daylight. Back side: a white wooden wedding arch at the end of the aisle, hung with sheer white drapes and garlands of white roses, peonies and greenery, with a tall clipped hedge and leafy trees behind it. A straight aisle of white petals on a pale runner runs down the middle of the lawn from the camera to the arch, between two short rows of white folding chairs that face the arch. Left side: a clipped boxwood hedge and, in front of it, a small round white high cocktail table holding a silver tray. Right side: white rose bushes along a low cream stone garden wall. Front side (behind the camera): a gravel path from the venue's terrace, the way in, where the aisle begins. Sunlight comes from high on the right and gives warm, soft highlights.

Avoid: people, readable text, logos, watermark, any door or window the description does not name.
